title: More Tools Fabric
description: This minecraft mod adds more tools. The carbon fiber blade, and the Gemstone axe. More tools in later updates. Only 1.21.8
body: _This brand-new minecraft mod adds more tools to minecraft!_ The carbon fiber blade, and the Gemstone axe! Both of them are really hard to get.  More tools in later updates. **Only for fabric and Minecraft Version 1.21.8** Im sorry I suck at making pixel art also, the models are terible.
